newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gas leak kills at least 18 in Pakistani city.
newsitem.headline: Gas leak kills at least 18 in Pakistani city.

text.p: At least 18 people died and about 700 were taken to hospital after ammonia gas leaked from a tanker truck in the Pakistani city of Lahore, police and doctors said on Thursday.
Hospital doctors reported 18 people had died from ammonia asphyxiation among more than 700 people brought for treatment.
Officials said the gas had escaped from a tanker truck passing through a congested area where many railway employees live in the Punjab provincial capital's Mughalpura district late on Wednesday.
Doctors at Caron hospital, the nearest to the scene, said they were treating about 500 people and seven had died.
"People started rushing out of their houses choking," a witness said, describing scenes of panic. "Some fell unconscious and nobody was in a position to help the other."
Reporters who toured the locality later said the gas had largely dispersed, though an acrid smell remained.
Police and troops were patrolling the streets in gas masks and the bodies of many animals, including buffalo, lay where they had choked to death, they said.
The governor of Punjab province, Khawaja Ahmed Tariq Rahim, supervised relief operations on the spot.
The provincial administration declared an emergency at all hospitals, the official news agency APP reported.
